# Johnson Controls OpenBlue digital ecosystem recognized as a Leader by Verdantix


November 19, 2026


Share


-
-
-
-


Verdantix, an independent, trusted, expert-led intelligence platform, named Johnson Controls a Leader in its[2026 Green Quadrant: Unified Building Orchestration Platforms](https://www.verdantix.com/insights/blog/the-race-to-autonomous-buildings-has-begun--inside-the-green-quadrant-on-unified-building-orchestration-platforms) report for the capabilities of the OpenBlue digital ecosystem.


The Verdantix report evaluates technologies that connect building systems and data to support more automated operations. Platforms were assessed on their ability to go beyond core capabilities — like connecting across systems, sending basic commands and using analytics to identify operational issues — towards autonomous action.


As buildings and critical environments become more complex and energy intensive, operators need greater intelligence to improve efficiency, reliability and performance. Powered by AI and an integrated AI-native data platform, OpenBlue gives operators visibility across complex building systems, supporting outcomes including reduced energy use, predictive maintenance, more effective space planning and agentic AI execution.


[Read the full report.](https://www.verdantix.com/insights/blog/the-race-to-autonomous-buildings-has-begun--inside-the-green-quadrant-on-unified-building-orchestration-platforms)
